2607.19787.title: Physics-Aware Complex-Valued State Space Model with Scattering-Prior Feature Modulation for PolSAR Image Classification
2607.19787.paper_summary: Polarimetric synthetic aperture radar (PolSAR) image classification is a representative task for physics-aware GeoAI, where land-cover semantics are closely coupled with electromagnetic scattering mechanisms. Many existing complex-valued networks can preserve amplitude-phase information, but they are often limited in long-range spatial dependency modeling and usually incorporate polarimetric priors only as input-level or shallow auxiliary features. As a result, physical knowledge is insufficiently used to guide deep feature evolution. To address this issue, this paper proposes CV-SSMNet, a physics-aware complex-valued state-space network with scattering-aware feature modulation for PolSAR image classification. The proposed method builds a complex-valued state-space model (CV-SSM) in the original complex domain to capture long-range spatial dependencies while preserving polarimetric amplitude-phase coupling. Meanwhile, seven physically meaningful scattering priors, are encoded as FiLM-style modulation signals to adaptively recalibrate complex-valued representations during feature evolution. CV-SSMNet further integrates multi-scale complex convolutions, branch-wise CV-SSM encoding, prior-guided recalibration, and lightweight global context aggregation, enabling physically guided representation learning from local scattering structures to global spatial context. Experiments on three L-band benchmark datasets and an additional P-band BIOMASS evaluation demonstrate that CV-SSMNet achieves competitive accuracy, improved regional consistency, and better boundary preservation, supporting the effectiveness of embedding polarimetric scattering mechanisms into complex-valued long-range GeoAI representation learning.
2607.19787.paper_summary_zh: 極化合成孔徑雷達（PolSAR）影像分類是物理知識驅動的GeoAI中的一個代表性任務，土地覆蓋語義與電磁散射機制密切相關。許多現有的複數值網絡能夠保留幅度-相位信息，但它們在長距離空間依賴建模方面通常受到限制，並且通常僅將極化先驗作為輸入級別或淺層輔助特徵納入。因此，物理知識未能充分用於指導深層特徵的演變。為了解決這一問題，本文提出了CV-SSMNet，一種具有散射感知特徵調制的物理知識驅動複數值狀態空間網絡，用於PolSAR影像分類。所提出的方法在原始複數域中建立了一個複數值狀態空間模型（CV-SSM），以捕捉長距離空間依賴，同時保留極化幅度-相位耦合。與此同時，七個具有物理意義的散射先驗被編碼為FiLM風格的調制信號，以在特徵演變過程中自適應地重新校準複數值表示。CV-SSMNet進一步整合了多尺度複數卷積、分支式CV-SSM編碼、先驗引導的重新校準和輕量級全局上下文聚合，實現了從局部散射結構到全局空間上下文的物理引導表示學習。在三個L波段基準數據集和一個額外的P波段BIOMASS評估上的實驗表明，CV-SSMNet實現了具有競爭力的準確性、改善的區域一致性和更好的邊界保留，支持將極化散射機制嵌入複數值長距離GeoAI表示學習的有效性。
